intro: This describes what information PropertyOS collects, why, and how it's handled. PropertyOS is a personal tool for managing your own properties, so most of what it stores is information you enter yourself.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body:
Account information: your email address and password (passwords are never stored in readable form — they're handled by our authentication provider, Supabase, using industry-standard hashing). Profile information you provide: your first and last name.

Record data you enter: owner profiles (name, relation, phone, email, and — optionally — Aadhaar and PAN numbers), property details, tenant details, agreements, rent and utility-bill records, and any documents you upload for them.

sections.heading: 2. How we use it
sections.body: To operate the app: authenticate you, store and display your records, and show you compliance reference information relevant to what you've entered. We do not use your data for advertising, and we do not sell it to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Aadhaar, PAN and other sensitive information
sections.body: Aadhaar and PAN numbers are optional fields, collected only because certain Maharashtra rental agreements require an owner's Aadhaar/PAN to be recorded as Licensor. These are sensitive identifiers under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, and we handle them with the same access controls as the rest of your data — they are never shared, and are visible only to your own account. Enter them only when you intend to use that owner's profile on an agreement.

sections.heading: 4. Where your data is stored
sections.body: PropertyOS uses Supabase (a third-party backend provider) to store your account and record data, encrypted in transit and at rest. Access to your records is restricted at the database level so that only your own authenticated account can read or write them.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing
sections.body: We don't sell your data or share it with advertisers. Your information is only accessible to you, and to our infrastructure providers (currently Supabase) strictly as needed to run the service — they don't use it for their own purposes.

sections.heading: 6. How long we keep it
sections.body: Your records are kept for as long as your account exists. If you delete a record (for example, an owner profile) it's removed from active storage; if you delete your account, your associated data is removed within a reasonable period, subject to any backups being cycled out.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You can view, edit or delete most records directly in the app. You can request a copy of your data, or full account deletion, by contacting us using the details below.

sections.heading: 8. Children's privacy
sections.body: PropertyOS is intended for adult property owners and is not directed at children. We don't knowingly collect information from anyone under 18.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to this policy
sections.body: If this policy changes materially, we'll update the effective date here. Continuing to use PropertyOS after a change means you accept the updated policy.

sections.heading: 10. Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy, or requests about your data, can be sent to [add a support/contact email here].
